purpose: choose technology on evidence and fit, so the team gets tools it can run and change for the life of the product
entry_criteria: Team skills and operating model are known
procedure: Write the criteria first: fit to requirements, team skill, maturity, security record, cost, licence, vendor risk and exit cost.
Weight the criteria with the stakeholders before scoring any option.
Test the top candidates with a short proof of concept on the riskiest requirement.
Score each option with evidence, and check licences and the support and release history.
Choose, and record the decision with rejected options and the conditions that would reopen it.
Add the choice to the approved technology list with an owner and review date.
deliverables: decision record and technology list entry
acceptance_criteria: Criteria and weights were set before scoring
A proof of concept tested the riskiest requirement
Licence and exit cost were checked

validation.check: check the criteria file is dated before the scoring file
read the licence of the chosen technology against the intended use

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Two message brokers are compared. A one-day proof of concept at the expected peak rate shows one cannot keep ordering; the other is chosen, with a note to reopen the decision if volume exceeds ten times the test.
